title: Present Continuous for Future Arrangements
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes usar el Presente Continuo para hablar de reuniones y planes que ya están agendados y confirmados.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Presente Continuo para el Futuro

parts.visual: Usamos el Presente Continuo (am/is/are + -ing) para hablar de planes futuros que ya están FIJOS y AGENDADOS. I am meeting the client tomorrow (Me reuniré con el cliente mañana - ya está en mi agenda).
parts.audio: We use the Present Continuous for future plans that are already FIXED and ARRANGED. I am meeting the client tomorrow means it is already in my calendar.

parts.visual: A menudo usamos expresiones de tiempo futuro para que quede claro: tomorrow, next week, at 3 PM. She is flying to London next Monday (Ella vuela a Londres el próximo lunes).
parts.audio: We often use future time expressions to make it clear: tomorrow, next week, at 3 PM. She is flying to London next Monday.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Presente Continuo para planes futuros.

questions.question: I ____ the client tomorrow at 10 AM. (Me reúno).
They ____ the new product on Friday. (Lanzan).
He ____ work early today. He has an appointment. (Sale de).
____ you attending the conference next month? (¿Asistirás?).
What ____ she doing tomorrow morning? (¿Qué hará?).
I am not ____ to the office tomorrow. (No iré).
The CEO ____ visiting our branch next week. (Visita).
We ____ having a team lunch on Friday. (Tendremos).
I am ____ a workshop on Thursday. (Asisto/Tomando).
She is ____ the project next month. (Empezando).
He is not ____ the meeting this afternoon. (No asiste).
We are ____ to the new office in December. (Nos mudamos).
I am ____ the budget with the manager at 2 PM. (Revisando).
They are ____ a new branch next year. (Abriendo).
Is he ____ a speech at the event? (¿Dará?).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en Presente Continuo para planes futuros (ej: am meeting, is going).

questions.question: I ____ ____ to the office tomorrow. (not go)

pairs.source: I am meeting the client tomorrow
pairs.target: Me reúno con el cliente mañana

pairs.source: We are having a team lunch
I am not going to the office

pairs.target: Nos mudamos el mes que viene
